Name: (WIP Updating) Bow for Abigail's Portrait
Author: ClockworkAngels
Description:
[u][i]Description:[/i][/u]
I wish Abigail's cute bow was actually visible on her portrait, since it's so prominent on her sprite. Many modded portraits unfortunately don't have one either, including Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic. I decided to finally change that with a quick edit that adds a small blue bow to Abigail's portrait.

There are several other mods like this already, but this one uses Poltergeister's edited portrait from the Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod as a base.

 If you want a completely vanilla Abigail face with just a bow in her portrait and no other changes, look for the other options on Nexus. If you want a "cuter" Abigail with a bow or you use Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, use my mod.

[u][i]Requirements:
[/i][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
(Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]

[u][i]Installation:[/i][/u]
Download the mod and follow the instructions inside of the folders. Everything is labelled and there are text documents with detailed instructions.

[u][i]Credits:
[/i][/u]ConcernedApe and Poltergeister did all the heavy lifting here; I just added a simple bow per Poltergeister's open permissions on their mod page.
